Welcome!
Taking the time to learn the basics, recreating some tutorials, and just experimenting will help when you want to make a specific game project.
Take your time and enjoy what you do.
Good luck!

posts.author: Timeline_man
posts.body:
Welcome to a brand new (old) world! My biggest tips are to use this method for trying to get answers to any question:
check the help file. There's a lot more in there than you'd think
type a google search
added onto this is not to rely on the forum search here, it's not the best...
THEN consider a forum thread
If you want to ignore this, be warned, there is some sharp sarcasm on this forum for repeated threads
